verdicts.evidence: An AST-based audit of the released code found 19 registered tools, 8 skill documents, implementations for all 8 pipeline stages, and a Claude Agent SDK streaming loop with a stepwise tool-use system prompt, but the pipeline was never executed, the ReAct loop is delegated to Claude SDK rather than locally implemented, and the 'first' claim was not evaluated.

No experiments were run: the required model (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) is retired, the 306 original traces and predictions are not released, and the repository provides no automatic success judge; the only check was source-text concordance (finding '68.9' in the LaTeX), which the logbook itself states is not reproduction evidence.

An independent JSONL parser on sp_bench.jsonl found 102 records with 102 unique IDs and queries, recomputed 18 categories and 8 stages, and confirmed tier counts of {basic: 40, intermediate: 28, advanced: 21, challenging: 13}, exactly matching the claim; schema, stage-count, and tier-complexity consistency checks all passed.

The released evaluator implements the five metric families, but the official dataset lacks CRC-CODEX evaluation inputs, generated quantification outputs, and the complete ground-truth bundle, so the reported 0.953/0.902/0.368 values cannot be recomputed.

Four ground-truth files (2,013,525 rows) pass structural schema checks, but original agent predictions are absent so the 0.681 average cannot be recomputed; the evaluator also has an order-sensitive fast-path bug and one ground-truth file has repeated cellLabel values, noted as qualifications rather than refutations.

overall: The logbook independently verifies the SP-Bench construction (102 queries, 18 categories, 8 stages, exact tier splits) via direct JSONL parsing and partially confirms the agent architecture via static code audit (19 tools, 8 stages, Claude SDK loop). The three numerical performance claims (execution accuracy, CRC-CODEX metrics, annotation similarity) remain unverified because original traces, predictions, and evaluation inputs are missing and no experiments were executed.
